description: 2 tactical challenges for White in the Danish Gambit. Sacrifice both c-pawns with 3.c3! and develop with lightning speed.

drills.briefExplanation: 3.c3! dxc3 4.Bc4 cxb2 5.Bxb2 — two pawns for two bishops and a raging initiative.
drills.description: White to play. Black took on d4 — offer the Danish with 3.c3!.
drills.explanation: The Danish Gambit: White sacrifices one pawn, then a second, for massive development. After 3.c3! dxc3 4.Bc4 cxb2 5.Bxb2 White has two bishops raking the center, a lead in development, and open lines — full compensation for the pawns. Black's extra material is meaningless if the king never castles. Gambit play at its purest.
drills.name: The Double Sacrifice

drills.briefExplanation: 4.exd5 Qxd5 5.cxd4 Nc6 6.Nf3 — trade, open the center, and chase the queen.
drills.description: White to play. Black declined with 3...d5 — trade and open the position.
drills.explanation: Against the solid 3...d5, White keeps the initiative by trading: 4.exd5 Qxd5 5.cxd4 — now the center is open, and after 5...Nc6 6.Nf3 White develops with tempo on the queen. White's bishops have free scope, Black's queen is a target, and the gambit spirit survives the decline.
drills.name: Opening the Center
